title: JournalBatch
description: A journal batch containing one or more journal entries for posting to the general ledger

JeBatchId.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the journal batch

Status.description: Current status of the journal batch

LedgerName.description: Name of the ledger associated with this batch

DefaultEffectiveDate.description: Default effective date for journals in this batch

CreatedBy.description: Username of the person who created the batch

CreationDate.description: Timestamp when the batch was created

LastUpdateDate.description: Timestamp when the batch was last modified
